overview:
The playwright MCP server provides 21 tools for various tasks.

Available tools:
1. browser_close: Close the page
2. browser_resize: Resize the browser window
3. browser_console_messages: Returns all console messages
4. browser_handle_dialog: Handle a dialog
5. browser_evaluate: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element
6. browser_file_upload: Upload one or multiple files
7. browser_fill_form: Fill multiple form fields
8. browser_press_key: Press a key on the keyboard
9. browser_type: Type text into editable element
10. browser_navigate: Navigate to a URL
11. browser_navigate_back: Go back to the previous page in the history
12. browser_network_requests: Returns all network requests since loading the page
13. browser_run_code: Run Playwright code snippet
14. browser_take_screenshot: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.
15. browser_snapshot: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot
16. browser_click: Perform click on a web page
17. browser_drag: Perform drag and drop between two elements
18. browser_hover: Hover over element on page
19. browser_select_option: Select an option in a dropdown
20. browser_tabs: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.
21. browser_wait_for: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

This server is designed to help with tasks related to browser automation and web interaction.

tools.name: browser_run_code
tools.description: Run Playwright code snippet

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load code from the specified file. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

usageScenarios: When the task matches the tool's purpose

inputParams.name: code
inputParams.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

inputParams.name: filename
inputParams.description: Load code from the specified file. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to screenshot the element. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If element is provided, ref must be provided too.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg}` if not specified. Prefer relative file names to stay within the output directory.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If ref is provided, element must be provided too.

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. Default is png.
